authority.captureProtocol: Control > Rewind and capture one-indexed frame 1 directly; for frames 2..N, invoke Control > Step Forward once before each lossless capture. Command-Right was tested and rejected because it did not advance this player.
authority.statement: Each PNG is captured from the untouched source SWF executing in Adobe's standalone Flash Player.
limitations: This scenario is standalone playback and does not reconstruct parent-movie variables or LMS/application host state.
Interactive branches not traversed in this scenario require separate scenario captures.
Audio hashes and synchronization require separate evidence in addition to silent PNG frames.
Runtime stepping stopped after frame 4: After frame 4, Adobe Flash Player 32.0.0.414 displayed Play, Rewind, Step Forward, Step Back, and Loop as disabled before requested frame 5.

alphaComposite.reason: macOS rounded-window masking makes the bottom stage corners transparent in window captures; those OS pixels are composited against the SWF-declared background rather than treated as Flash content.
